notes.text:
Just did my first playtest and there's a couple of thing I wanted to change.
If you've already gotten 0.5.0 all you'll need is the new .apworld. The .bps and .js files are for those who have this as their first versions.
-Fixed a bug where the Sticky Badge (Shop), Fast Foot Badge (Shop), and Feather Badge (Shop) locations were marked as "Unknown Location"
-Changed Wallets from Progression to Progression Deprioritized Skip Balancing
-Made it so HP Regen Badge is required to beat Agamemnon (logic wise, in-game you can do whatever you want)
